title: Citius Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Announces First Reported Revenue Following Successful Launch of LYMPHIR™
summary: Citius Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Citius Pharma" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: CTXR), a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the development and commercialization of first-in-class critical care products today reported business and financial results for the fiscal first quarter ended December 31, 2025, and provided a business update, including progress at its majority-owned subsidiary, Citius Oncology, Inc. (Nasdaq: CTOR). "I am thrilled to report that we have successfully transitioned to a revenue generating company following Citius Oncology's December 2025 launch of LYMPHIR. We recorded $3.9 million in revenue during the quarter, reflecting the initial sales at Citius Oncology's nationwide network of distributors. This milestone is the result of years of focused execution designed to translate innovation into tangible value for the cutaneous T-cell community and Citius stakeholders alike.
